query: INSERT INTO loyalty_customers (id, org_id, member_token, joined_branch_id, apple_auth_token) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET deleted_at = NULL, pass_voided_at = NULL, member_token = EXCLUDED.member_token, apple_auth_token = EXCLUDED.apple_auth_token, joined_branch_id = EXCLUDED.joined_branch_id, apple_serial = NULL, google_object_id = NULL, enrolled_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE loyalty_customers.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND loyalty_customers.org_id = EXCLUDED.org_id
